info.title: Cloudflare Queues
info.description: Cloudflare Queues: message queues, consumers, and producers.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Queue event subscriptions with optional sorting and filtering.

count.description: Number of items in current page

post.description: Creates an event subscription for a Queue.

events.description: List of event types this subscription handles

400.description: Invalid request body or validation errors

404.description: Queue does not exist or resource not found on source

405.description: Multiple subscriptions on same resource not supported

delete.description: Deletes an existing Queue event subscription.

get.description: Returns an existing Queue event subscription.

patch.description: Updates an existing Queue event subscription.

events.description: List of event types this subscription handles

400.description: Invalid request body or validation errors

404.description: Queue does not exist or resource not found on source

get.description: Returns the queues owned by an account.

200.description: List of all Queues that belong to this account

page.description: Current page within paginated list of queues

total_count.description: Total queues available without any search parameters

total_pages.description: Total pages available without any search parameters

post.description: Creates a Queue in the account.

get.description: Returns details about a specific Queue.

patch.description: Updates part of a Queue's configuration.

put.description: Replaces a Queue's configuration with the supplied configuration. This endpoint does not support partial updates.

get.description: Returns the consumers configured for a Queue.

200.description: All consumers attached to this Queue

post.description: Creates a consumer for a Queue.

delete.description: Deletes a consumer from a Queue.

get.description: Returns a Queue consumer by identifier.

put.description: Replaces a Queue consumer, or creates it if it does not exist.

post.description: Pushes a message to a Queue.
Acknowledges successfully processed Queue messages and retries messages that were not processed successfully.

ackCount.description: The number of messages that were succesfully acknowledged.

retryCount.description: The number of messages that were succesfully retried.

warnings.description: Map of lease IDs to warning messages encountered during acknowledgement.

post.description: Pushes a batch of messages to a Queue.
Extends message leases without incrementing the messages' `attempts` counters. Each message receives a new lease identifier.

extendCount.description: The number of message leases that were succesfully extended.

warnings.description: Map of lease IDs to warning messages encountered during extensions.

post.description: Peek messages from a Queue without leasing them. Each message includes a ref that can be passed to the purge endpoint, and remains available for subsequent peek or pull operations until it is purged.

200.description: A batch of peeked messages from the Queue

post.description: Preview messages from a Queue without leasing them. This deprecated route is retained for compatibility; use the peek endpoint for new integrations.

200.description: A batch of previewed messages from the Queue

post.description: Delete messages returned by the legacy preview endpoint. This deprecated route is retained for compatibility; use the peek and purge endpoints for new integrations. Deleting messages this way does not count as delivery and does not affect metrics.

warnings.description: Map of lease IDs to warning messages encountered during acknowledgement.

post.description: Pulls a batch of messages from a Queue for an HTTP pull consumer.

200.description: A batch of messages in the Queue

message_backlog_count.description: The number of unacknowledged messages in the queue.

post.description: Delete messages from a Queue by using refs returned by the peek endpoint. Purging messages does not count as delivery and does not affect metrics.

warnings.description: Map of refs to warning messages encountered during purge.

post.x-forge-require-confirmation: This operation permanently deletes the selected messages from the Queue.

get.description: Returns best-effort metrics for a Queue. Values may be approximate due to the distributed nature of Queues.
Returns the status of a Queue purge operation.

completed.description: Indicates if the last purge operation completed successfully.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the last purge operation started.

post.description: Starts a purge that deletes all messages from a Queue.

delete_messages_permanently.description: Confirms that all messages will be permanently deleted.

post.x-forge-require-confirmation: This operation drops every message in the queue.

success.description: Indicates if the API call was successful or not.
Indicates if the API call was successful or not.

mq_batch-size.description: The maximum number of messages to include in a batch.

mq_consumer-request.description: Request body for creating or updating a consumer

model_name.description: Name of the Workers AI model

events.description: List of event types this subscription handles

modified_at.description: When the subscription was last modified

dead_letter_queue.description: Name of the dead letter queue, or empty string if not configured

mq_lease-id.description: An ID that represents an "in-flight" message that has been pulled from a Queue. You must hold on to this ID and use it to acknowledge this message.

mq_max-concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent consumers that may consume from this Queue. Set to `null` to automatically opt in to the platform's maximum (recommended).

mq_max-wait-time.description: The number of milliseconds to wait for a batch to fill up before attempting to deliver it

delay_seconds.description: The number of seconds to wait for attempting to deliver this batch to consumers
The number of seconds to wait for attempting to deliver this message to consumers

mq_queue-metrics.description: Best-effort metrics for the queue. Values may be approximate due to the distributed nature of queues.

backlog_bytes.description: The size in bytes of unacknowledged messages in the queue.

backlog_count.description: The number of unacknowledged messages in the queue.

oldest_message_timestamp_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the oldest unacknowledged message in the queue. Returns 0 if unknown.

delivery_delay.description: Number of seconds to delay delivery of all messages to consumers.

delivery_paused.description: Indicates if message delivery to consumers is currently paused.

message_retention_period.description: Number of seconds after which an unconsumed message will be delayed.

mq_ref.description: An opaque reference to a peeked message. You must hold on to this value and use it to purge the message.

mq_retry-delay.description: The number of seconds to delay before making the message available for another attempt.

mq_visibility-timeout.description: The number of milliseconds that a message is exclusively leased. After the timeout, the message becomes available for another attempt.

dead_letter_queue.description: Name of the dead letter queue, or empty string if not configured
